fields.subject: the ArgentSea.Pg assembly
fields.response: grants visibility of its internal (non-public) types and members to the assembly named by the MSBuild property expression $(MSBuildProjectName).Test — i.e. this project's own name with a ".Test" suffix — via an InternalsVisibleTo item declared in this project file
fields.postcondition: so that this project's own test assembly can exercise ArgentSea.Pg's internal implementation details directly without those details being exposed as part of the package's public API
